doc.title: Indian Railways ticket cancellation refunds (summary of public rules, not an official IRCTC or Indian Railways statement)
doc.source_note: Summary of public rules, not an official IRCTC or Indian Railways statement. Each version's sources are in its clauses' change notes.

versions.basis: Railway Passengers (Cancellation of Ticket and Refund of Fare) Rules, 2015, G.S.R. 836(E), dated 4 November 2015, in force from 12 November 2015.

sections.heading: Cancellation of confirmed tickets
sections.text: For a confirmed ticket cancelled more than 48 hours before the scheduled departure of the train, the cancellation charge is a flat amount per passenger, plus GST on AC classes: Rs 240 for AC First Class and Executive Class, Rs 200 for AC 2-tier and First Class, Rs 180 for AC 3-tier, AC Chair Car and AC 3 Economy, Rs 120 for Sleeper Class and Rs 60 for Second Class. For a confirmed ticket cancelled between 48 hours and 12 hours before the scheduled departure, the charge is 25% of the fare, subject to the minimum flat charge for the class. For a confirmed ticket cancelled between 12 hours and 4 hours before the scheduled departure, the charge is 50% of the fare, subject to the minimum flat charge for the class. For a confirmed ticket cancelled less than 4 hours before the scheduled departure, no refund is given.

versions.basis: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw's announcement of 24 March 2026: an announcement, not a gazette notification; phased in between 1 and 15 April 2026 per press reports; this summary applies it from 15 April 2026.

sections.heading: Cancellation of confirmed tickets
sections.text: For a confirmed ticket cancelled more than 72 hours before the scheduled departure of the train, only the minimum flat cancellation charge per passenger applies. For a confirmed ticket cancelled between 72 hours and 24 hours before the scheduled departure, 25% of the fare is charged. For a confirmed ticket cancelled between 24 hours and 8 hours before the scheduled departure, 50% of the fare is charged and 50% is refunded. For a confirmed ticket cancelled less than 8 hours before the scheduled departure, no refund is given.

limitations: IRCTC's refund page still shows the 2015 slabs (48, 12 and 4 hours) as of 12 November 2026.
G.S.R. 41(E) of 16 January 2026, a separate gazette rule for Vande Bharat Sleeper and Amrit Bharat II trains only, is not modelled.
